rejectedAlternative: l26 unresolved-clump opacity is not used.

extinction.prescription: The inherited fixed broad-channel A_lambda/A_V proxies are R=0.75, G=1, B=1+1/3.41. A single global scalar multiplies optical depth in all channels; no new spectral or dust color parameter is fitted.

inputs: The exact l25 OGLE ordering, HERITAGE native structure and original Bell normalization are reused. Their citations and acquisition records remain in the parent.
unchanged: All Gaia stars, density maps, catalogue objects, per-object amplitudes, RGB coefficients and display curve.
assumption: The fitted scalar calibrates effective optical depth to a processed optical photo. It is not a new measured dust-mass map or a revision to stellar distances.
